goal: Migrate demo portfolio to Supabase user_portfolios as Single Source of Truth (SSOT), preventing localStorage race conditions on client mount, and implement backend user portfolio persistence in supabase_client.py

contracts.interfaces: get_user_portfolio, upsert_user_portfolio, delete_user_portfolio_holding in SupabaseClient and SSOT gating in PortfolioContext
function_signatures: upsert_user_portfolio(self, user_id: str, symbol: str, asset: str, amount: float, avg_buy_price: float) -> Dict[str, Any]
delete_user_portfolio_holding(self, user_id: str, identifier: str) -> bool

execution_steps: Write test in test_portfolio_ssot.py verifying portfolio queries and SSOT hydration safety
Run python test_portfolio_ssot.py to verify failure (red phase)
Implement get_user_portfolio, upsert_user_portfolio, and delete_user_portfolio_holding in supabase_client.py
Update PortfolioContext.tsx to gate local-to-cloud sync with isCloudPortfolioLoaded and prioritize cloud holdings as SSOT
Run python test_portfolio_ssot.py to verify green phase
Run lint and typecheck verification commands
acceptance_criteria: supabase_client.py provides get_user_portfolio querying user_portfolios table by user_id
supabase_client.py provides upsert_user_portfolio upserting row with on_conflict resolution
supabase_client.py provides delete_user_portfolio_holding deleting row by user_id and symbol/asset
PortfolioContext.tsx gates localHoldings sync with isCloudPortfolioLoaded so stale localStorage cannot wipe or overwrite cloud holdings on initial load

rollback.command: git checkout HEAD -- supabase_client.py frontend/src/contexts/PortfolioContext.tsx; rm -f test_portfolio_ssot.py contracts/TSK-CLOUD-009.contract.json
